findings.evidence: "Always put mockups in fenced blocks: outside one, Markdown uses a proportional font and collapses repeated spaces." This and the tab-stop explanation repeat familiar formatting knowledge rather than adding expert layout decisions.
findings.fix: Compress the routine formatting explanations into one constraint: "Use spaces inside fenced mockups, never tabs; if the drawing contains backticks, use a four-backtick or tilde fence." Retain the display-cell validation, terminal-width caveats, overflow ordering and ranked-task layout rules.
